text: Beast watched a three minute Blender tutorial and kept eighty frames, each tied to its timestamp.
Fourteen values were read off the screen, four of them never spoken, and type checked. Anything unresolved is refused, not guessed.
The procedure ran in Blender with no human in the loop. The materials read back exactly as compiled.
A local vision model scored the result against the tutorial. Then Beast exported the glass as a model.
This video is that model, rendered frame by frame from the recorded inputs. Re-render it and every frame matches.
